claim_ceiling: Evaluation v6 demonstrates that no signal ablation variant outperforms the center_projected baseline on the expanded 1,200-decision slice under adversarial benchmarks. Hybrids at alpha=0.3 approach baseline performance but do not exceed it. Pure legal signals overfit to language artifacts. Citation graph signal is degenerate on this slice. Jurist pairwise and cross-language retrieval thresholds are unachievable by any variant.
evidence_summary: Complete adversarial evaluation of 15 variants on 1,200 decisions across 5 benchmark suites (cross-language, jurist usability, Jurivoc, scale stability, boilerplate resistance skipped). Baseline center_projected (768-dim) remains best composite performer: PASS language dominance (0.7738), highest jurist legal_neighbor_rate (0.4912), best Jurivoc hierarchy separation (0.0956), best cross-language retrieval (0.1456). No variant achieves jurist pairwise >0.5 or cross-language retrieval >0.2. Citation_weights variant produces degenerate zero embeddings. Scale stability test lacks discriminative power (all cosine=1.0 after PCA projection). All negative/null results honestly represented. No data leakage, benchmark gaming, or unsupported claims detected.
